space.expression: Depends on the SVP oracle and embedding implementation.

notes: Kannan embedding cost model stated with the empirical uSVP gap-to-reduction parameter τ. It is not a theorem that a root-Hermite factor alone solves every uSVP instance.

extra.parameters: Fix n,q, Gaussian width αq; ε′>1 controls the error tail; τ≤1 and ε_τ model uSVP success; m≈√(nlog₂q/log₂δ₀).
extra.noise: Discrete Gaussian width αq, standard deviation αq/√(2π).
extra.samples: At least optimized m samples; cap the choice by the actual sample budget.
extra.objective: Recover the secret by BDD-to-uSVP embedding.
extra.model: Source uses embedding factor t=||e||; success model ε_τ for gap τδ₀^m.
extra.assumptions: Gaussian heuristic for q-ary lattice minima; empirically calibrated uSVP success law.

evidence.locator: §5.5, Lemmas 5.17–5.18, pp. 190–191; Lemma 5.17 is attributed to Albrecht–Fitzpatrick–Göpfert Lemma 2
evidence.sourceVersion: Journal of Mathematical Cryptology 9(3), published 2 October 2015
